_comment: Status effect definitions (Steve 2026-10-07). Data-driven status framework: the engine (src/js/statusEffects.js) reads these. Scopes: scholar (dayPart ticks via advancePart), combat (per-turn ticks via tbBeginTurn). Stun-family bridges legacy stunned/stunFull fields so existing consumption code keeps working. Poison/disease mirror s.poisons/s.diseases so herbal_remedy/purify keep working.

bleed.description: Open wound. It won't close on its own while you keep moving.
bleed.name: Bleeding

burn.description: Skin seared. The heat keeps eating.
burn.name: Burning

disease.cureText: Bitter tea, steam, rest. The fever breaks. ({source})
disease.description: Fever by nightfall. The body fights something it can't see.
disease.expireText: The fever breaks on its own. {name} {verb} through it.
disease.name: Diseased

fear.description: Something in the gut says run. The hands don't always listen.
fear.name: Afraid

poison.cureText: Charcoal, clean water, time. The poison leaves. ({source})
poison.description: Toxin in the blood. It burns through you a little at a time.
poison.expireText: The poison runs its course. {name} {verb} through it.
poison.name: Poisoned

slow.description: Heavy limbs. Every step costs double.
slow.name: Slowed
slow.notes: v1: player moveLeft wired in tbBeginTurn. Monster step loops (m.speed) pending — engine API seMoveMod/seSteps ready.

stun.description: Frozen mid-step. Movement is gone, but the hands still work.
stun.name: Stunned

stun_full.description: The world tilts. The whole turn slips past.
stun_full.name: Stunned (full)

howlbelly.description: Howlbelly (hushwolf meat): at night you howl without deciding to — wanderers hear it. Small monsters hear what's in your gut and think twice.
howlbelly.expireText: The ache fades. Your throat is your own again.
howlbelly.name: Howlbelly

gristlefit.description: Gristlefit (bulldozer meat): +25% strike damage, but rage fits may lash out at whoever's nearest — friend or foe.
gristlefit.expireText: Your shoulders drop. The world stops insulting you.
gristlefit.name: Gristlefit

croakbelly.cureText: One last ribbit, small and sad. ({source})
croakbelly.description: Croakbelly (choir toad meat): your gut ribbits audibly (-stealth), but choir toads hear kin and won't start anything.
croakbelly.expireText: One last ribbit, small and sad. Gone.
croakbelly.name: Croakbelly

shellgut.description: Shellgut (speedbump meat): gut armored — immune to ingested poison and food-borne disease, but food moves slow (-25% kcal absorbed, digestion clanks).
shellgut.expireText: The armor passes. Loudly. You don't look back.
shellgut.name: Shellgut

witness_maw.description: Witness Maw (grief counselor meat): black tears, night half as dark — but people decide you're possessed (-trust).
witness_maw.expireText: Your tears run clear again. People stop edging away.
witness_maw.name: Witness Maw

flockmind.description: Flockmind (duck-line meat): you quack when startled — surprise is impossible — but duck-lines recognize flock and won't start anything.
flockmind.expireText: The urge to follow fades. You walk like yourself again. Probably.
flockmind.name: Flockmind
